messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: hosted-runtime pool-7 kv-cache resident memory spike detected (>92%) across 6/8 replicas. Auto-evict pressure triggered. See monitor: https://metrics/redwood/alerts/kv-cache-spike/3290012345

maria (oncall): seeing 5xxs and degraded tail latency for the hosted tier. Is this the long-prompt regression we patched last week?

alex (eng-runtime): looking at logs now. early signal is lots of extremely long contexts + aggressive continuous prefetch walking the entire KV window. possibly a prefix amplification loop.

jordan (sre): any customer-facing impact severity? we need to page CS if it's >10% errors or sustained 30s+ tail latency.

sam (support): current alerts: two customers reported generation failures; error rate on text-generation route is 12% over the last 3m, avg p95 latency 2.4s -> 6.8s. marking incident P1.

lina (eng-ml): can we confirm model variants? this looks like large context sessions on hosted-bert-xxl variant; that model keeps lots of KV state which multiplies with prefetch.

alex (eng-runtime): immediate mitigation plan: 1) disable continuous prefetch on hosted tier (config flag), 2) lower batching max_seq to 1024 for affected pool, 3) increase kv-cache eviction aggressiveness (--evict-aggressive). if that buys time we can roll a narrower hotfix.

maria (oncall): do it. jordan, can you apply prefetched disable? i will take ownership for external comms. alex/jordan, coordinate the hotfix.

jordan (sre): doing step 1 now: runbook snippet:
```bash
# toggle continuous prefetch off for hosted-runtime:pool-7
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' 
  https://controlplane.internal/configs/pools/pool-7/toggle 
  -d '{"continuous_prefetch": false}'
```
execute: `curl ...` -> 202 accepted.

incident-bot: CONFIG CHANGE: continuous_prefetch=false applied to pool-7 by jordan at 3290012380.

alex (eng-runtime): confirmed on node logs: prefetch loops stopped. KV allocations trending down. injecting a temporary batch cap:
```json
{"batch_max_tokens": 1024}
```
applied via orchestration (canary 10%).

lina (eng-ml): adding to note: some prompt patterns generate exponential KV entries due to repeated session-prefixing. need eval later but not now.

jordan (sre): eviction turbo applied: `--evict-window-multiplier=2.5` across remaining replicas. memory util dropping from 94% -> 68% over ~40s on canary.

sam (support): customer impact update: error rate down to 3% in last 2m, p95 latency 1.8s. opening status update draft for status page. pinging affected accounts.

maria (oncall): good. alex, do we need to roll a code hotfix or can a config-only rollback suffice for now?

alex (eng-runtime): config-only buys ~15min stable. we should push a small hotfix that adds a short-circuit for sessions exceeding 128k tokens in KV growth and caps prefetch window per-session. i'll prepare a patch and ask deploy-bot for a canary rollout.

alex (eng-runtime): small patch: `runtime: cap_session_kv_entries=131072; prefetch_window_limit=4096` -> compiled and smoke tested locally. pushing to staging. commit: b8f3c2d.

deploy-bot: DEPLOY START: rolling canary b8f3c2d -> hosted-runtime pool-7 (10% -> 30% if stable).

jordan (sre): metrics look stable on canary nodes. increasing to 30%. memory and error rates flat.

incident-bot: ESCALATION NOTE: oncall handoff required in 30m for monitoring and postmortem. maria to coordinate.

maria (oncall): handing off to jordan at shift change. jordan, you'll own follow-up and blameless postmortem. i'll post the customer-facing update now and keep on-call artifacts in the incident doc. :thumbsup:

jordan (sre): taking it. will keep watch and start a timeline. next steps: 1) finalize hotfix rollout to 100% if no regression, 2) create alert guardrails for per-session kv growth, 3) schedule eval to identify prompt patterns that cause prefix amplification.

sam (support): posted status page: "We are investigating elevated errors for hosted text-generation; mitigation in progress. Some customers may see transient failures."

lina (eng-ml): will coordinate with product to add prompt-pattern tests to CI so we catch this earlier.

alex (eng-runtime): rolling to 100% now. deploy-bot reports success across pool-7 at 3290012675: all replicas healthy.

incident-bot: RESOLVED: memory/utilization returned to normal and errors dropped below thresholds. root cause under investigation. incident severity downgraded to P2 for follow-up.

maria (oncall): thanks team. jordan will own postmortem. sam to continue customer comms. leaving notes in incident doc and adding postmortem label.

jordan (sre): initial blameless notes: runaway per-session prefetch + long-prompt prefix amplification + no per-session kv guards = OOM risk. next: add per-session caps, better defaults for hosted tier, and alerts that detect sustained kv growth per-session.

sam (support): closing loop with flagged customers; offered compensatory credits where appropriate.

maria (oncall): incident closed for live mitigation; follow-ups tracked in a new ticket: INF-6721 (postmortem & fixes).

alex (eng-runtime): queued ML eval + config defaults PR. thanks everyone. :heart:
